descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Small UFO. Big trouble. Plenty of “oops.”
Take the pilot’s seat in UFOops!, a playful VR abduction adventure where an ordinary day on Earth becomes your next collection mission. Fly over a glowing night city, explore the countryside, and use your tractor beam to scoop up unsuspecting citizens, farm animals, and even vehicles.
Your cockpit is your home among the chaos. Work the controls, watch your onboard displays, and enjoy the strange little alien decorations that give your ship its personality. Look through the window, line up your next target, and let the trouble begin.
Pick a world. Choose your kind of chaos.
Take on Missions for specific objectives and extra rewards, or choose Free Roam to explore at your own pace. Track down particular citizens, hunt for the right vehicle, or head out over the fields in search of wandering animals.
Keep your beam steady.
Abducting a person is one thing. Lifting a vehicle takes more commitment. Purchase Heavy Lift charges with your earned credits, hold your beam on the target through the countdown, and watch it rise. Break your lock too soon, and you’ll need to line up another attempt.
Get paid for causing a little extraterrestrial inconvenience.
Earn credits from abductions and collect bigger payouts for completing tasks. Spend your earnings to unlock another world and stock up on vehicle-lifting charges before your next outing.
Inside UFOops!, you’ll find:
- Cockpit-based VR flying with hands-on controls and onboard mission displays.
